answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 14746 Country: United States of America Title: Asslam o alaikum i want to keep my baby,s name Abdul Ali.can we keep the name Ali with abdul, as i read this name in quran as Allah,s name. what is the right spelling for this name? and in urdu how we can write it? jazak allah kheyr Question: Asslam o alaikum i want to keep my baby,s name Abdul Ali.can we keep the name Ali with abdul, as i read this name in quran as Allah,s name. what is the right spelling for this name? and in urdu how we can write it? jazak allah kheyr Answer ID: 14746 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1393/1138=D/1430) Yes, keeping the name Abdul Ali is alright. Al-Ali is one of the attributive names of Allah. You can name your child with Abdul Ali. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
